transcript: Launch week is noisy, and people decide in seconds. A short launch video gives everyone the same clear story, and your deck already holds most of it.
Write the explanation carefully once, and it keeps working. A prospect can watch at 10pm, and a partner can forward it to their boss.
Follow five beats. Start with a problem viewers recognise, like chasing late invoices on Friday afternoons. Then show the product, how it works, the proof, and where to go next.
Keep it shorter than you think. One to two minutes for product page and email, captioned clips for social. Thirty slides? Six to ten will do.
Build it from your existing launch deck. Cut internal slides and swap labels for claims: Reminders becomes, reminders go out on your schedule, not when you remember.
Your speaker notes become the voiceover. On Pro, a.i. directs each animated scene, so the reveal feels produced. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
